sources.entry: mem0 - An intelligent memory layer for AI agents enabling personalized interactions.
Mem0 - The memory layer for Personalized AI

summary.one_liner: Mem0 is a memory layer for AI assistants and agents that stores, retrieves, and personalizes context across user, session, and agent state, offered as a Python/npm library, a self-hosted server, and a managed cloud platform.
summary.what_it_does: Provides an API to add conversation messages and facts as memories, then search them by query with filters such as user_id. The library is installed via pip (mem0ai) or npm (mem0ai), and a basic example wraps an OpenAI chat loop so each reply is informed by retrieved memories and new memories are written back after each turn. A self-hosted server runs via docker compose with an admin bootstrap command and auth enabled by default, and a managed Cloud Platform is also offered. A CLI (@mem0/cli or mem0-cli) supports init, add, and search from the terminal. The README describes an April 2026 memory algorithm using single-pass ADD-only extraction, entity linking, and multi-signal retrieval (semantic, BM25 keyword, entity matching), with benchmark scores on LoCoMo, LongMemEval, and BEAM; these figures are for the managed platform, and the README says open-source users should expect similar but not identical results. Agent skills for coding assistants are also provided via npx skills add.
use_cases: Give a chatbot long-term memory of user preferences across sessions
Customer support bot that recalls past tickets and user history
Personalized AI assistant that remembers user details
Self-hosting a shared memory service for a team
Adding persistent memory to LangGraph or CrewAI agents
Managing agent memories from the command line
how_to_run: pip install mem0ai[nlp] && python -m spacy download en_core_web_sm (optional, for BM25 and entity extraction)
cd server && make bootstrap (self-hosted server, one command)
cd server && docker compose up -d (self-hosted server, manual setup via browser wizard)
stack: OpenAI models (default gpt-5-mini LLM, text-embedding-3-small embeddings)
notable: Single-pass ADD-only memory extraction, so memories accumulate rather than being overwritten
Hybrid retrieval combining semantic search, BM25 keyword matching, and entity linking
Multiple deployment paths: library, self-hosted server, managed cloud, and CLI
Agent-oriented signup: agents can mint an API key via the mem0 init --agent command
Accompanying research paper (arXiv 2504.19413) and open-sourced evaluation framework
caveats: Requires an LLM; defaults to OpenAI gpt-5-mini and text-embedding-3-small unless configured otherwise
Benchmark numbers come from the managed platform with proprietary optimizations; open-source results are expected to differ
Self-hosted auth is on by default and needs admin setup; the README notes AUTH_DISABLED=true is for local dev only
Some advanced features are listed as teasers in self-hosted mode and fully included only in the Cloud Platform
keywords: alternative to vector database for memory
